_comment: Upload activity and the Activity section of a context page (docs/architecture/context-activity.md): the pure mapping edits, step gates, period arithmetic and section shape (activity.helpers.js), the state and API calls of the wizard (useActivityUpload.js), the three reads and their refresh (useContextActivity.js, activityEvents.js), the step flow (UploadActivityWizard.jsx), who gets the card (UploadActivityCard.jsx) and what the section shows and to whom (ActivitySection.jsx). WHY: a period counted back one month off shows a different year of hours, a gate that lets a preview with nothing to import through writes an empty upload, a refresh that listens to every context re-reads the whole page on any import, and an Undo offered on a root's upload from a child's page removes every unit's activity. Run: cd app/ui && npm run test:mutation:contextactivity. TEST INCLUDE traces the importers: the helpers' own test and the two mount tests. MUTATOR SET: StringLiteral and ObjectLiteral excluded, matching the sibling configs. NOT YET MEASURED: break is deliberately absent until a first run measures a score (and see stryker.roles.config.json on the vitest 5 coverage regression before trusting any UI number).

mutationExclusions.src/components/contexts/activity/Activit: Presentational form over the activity mapping: every change it makes is a call into withActivityRole / toggleAttribute (activity.helpers.js and uploadMapping.helpers.js), mutated in their configs; the pre-filled guess, the AI mark, the sub-unit field on a parent and the disabled unit without an amount are asserted by UploadActivityWizard.mount.test.jsx.

Presentational: prints the preview the API computed. Its lines come from importLine / skippedLine / membersLine (mutated with the helpers); the replace warning, the nothing-to-import message, near misses and unmatched sub-units with their row counts are asserted by UploadActivityWizard.mount.test.jsx.

Presentational: one table per group of people the API composed (contexts/activity/report.js decides the groups). What it renders per person and which names link where (personLink, mutated with the helpers) is asserted by ActivitySection.mount.test.jsx.

Presentational: the sub-unit x month table the API computed (report.js childSummary). Every cell of a two-unit table, the totals line, the hidden suggestion columns of a resource tree and the click to a sub-unit are asserted by ActivitySection.mount.test.jsx.

Presentational list of the history the API returned; its one decision -- Undo only for an analyst and only on an upload made on this context -- is asserted both ways by ActivitySection.mount.test.jsx, and its line text comes from uploadLine (mutated with the helpers).
mutationExclusions.src/components/contexts/activity/MonthBa: Presentational inline SVG: the heights come from barHeights (mutated with the helpers, tested with a zero month and a flat row); the accessible label with every month's amount is asserted by ActivitySection.mount.test.jsx.
mutationExclusions.src/components/contexts/upload/MappingFi: Presentational form pieces shared by both upload wizards (a column picker per role, the attribute checkboxes); every change they make is a callback the step passes in. Exercised end to end by UploadListFlow.mount.test.jsx and UploadActivityWizard.mount.test.jsx.
